card.name: Verbs and words introducing a list or finding
card.fires_on: The word right before a stated result or list, such as "showed" after a trial description, "following" after "The", or "of" after "The following list". It appears in medical information text.

modes.label: Result verb
modes.description: "showed" after a description of pooled trials, just before the finding is stated.
modes.example: behavior. Pooled analyses of 199 placebo-controlled clinical trials (mono- and adjunctive therapy) of 11 different AEDs<< showed>> that patients randomized to one of the A

modes.label: Introducing a list
modes.description: "following" or "of" in a phrase that leads into a list of tests or symptoms.
modes.example: one or more lymph nodes may be removed and checked for signs of cancer. The<< following>> tests may be done on the tissue that
